Art & Craft-cum Music Teacher (Part-time): Specialized in Music and any Art, Craft work. Weightage for work experienced candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://eluru.ap.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DWCWEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the DWCWEO Recruitment 2026 is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DWCWEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for various posts in the District Women & Child Welfare & Empowerment Office Eluru Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the DWCWEO posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 25 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from MBBS with Pediatric specialization to 10th class, Graduate degrees in Commerce/Mathematics, and specialized skills in Music and Art/Craft.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DWCWEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the various posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7944/- to Rs. 10000/- per month, depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the DWCWEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Women & Child Welfare & Empowerment Office Eluru (DWCWEO).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Women & Child Welfare & Empowerment Office Eluru, which is https://eluru.ap.gov.in.
